items.summary: Twenty years ago, I started this website because I wanted a place to share recipes I was excited about, as it’s practically coded into my DNA to be an unfettered yap about the things I love. [ This is me. ] The larger context was that upon reaching so-called adulthood, I’d found that while I knew how to cook, there were still so many things I hadn’t figured out, such as: how to turn a can of tomatoes into not just an okay pasta sauce, but a spectacular one ; how to make really good meatballs ; perfect hummus ; and a crumb cake I’d want to make forever. You’d think that 20 years and more than 1400 recipes later, I’d be closing this chapter. What could there possibly be left to know?
